description: This file defines functions for registering MCP (Message Communication Protocol) tools related to OpenClaw channels, including listing conversations, fetching messages, polling events, sending messages, and handling approvals. It imports external modules for server handling, data validation, and message processing.

methods.name: getChannelMcpCapabilities
methods.description: Returns MCP capabilities configuration based on the channel mode ('off', 'on', 'auto').

methods.name: registerChannelMcpTools
methods.description: Registers various MCP tools on the server for managing OpenClaw conversations, messages, events, and approvals.
